entries.candidate: Zhongshu Yunke Northern Data Lake (Fintech Industrial Park) (中数云科（内蒙古）科技有限公司北方数据湖（金融科技产业园）项目), Yungu area, Horinger New Area: four intelligent computing centres and an R&D centre
entries.status_candidate: under_construction (October 2025 EIA statement; outside the window)
entries.reason: New candidate with a strong official locator but no in-window status. The Hohhot EEB accepted on 14 October 2025 (local hh-zsyk-110kv-accept-20251014.html) the EIA report form for the park's own 110 kV substation (local hh-zsyk-110kv-eia-report-20251014.pdf, sha256 9d6ba03d..., captured directly with a 900 s-timeout copy of capture.mjs without a prior 45 s attempt; approval 6 November 2025). The report (builder 中数云科（内蒙古）科技有限公司, subsidiary of 中数兴盛科技有限责任公司) says the park will have four intelligent computing centres and one R&D centre with 5,672 24-kW racks, that the park was already under construction but unfinished in October 2025, and prints the substation centre N40°32'40.393", E111°48'21.735" at the park's north-west corner east of Shengguo Road (land sale: 3,381.147 m2 parcel 'north-west of the Northern Data Lake project, east of Shengguo Road', 和土储挂2025039). The site plan's CGCS2000 3-degree zone 37 coordinates (enclosure area 3,381.1 m2, equal to the land sale) put the station building centroid 0.2 m from the printed point, and Esri imagery shows a construction compound there, 483 m north-west of the BONC campus across Shuju West Street. No dated in-window record was found: the Horinger New Area news lists (28 July-26 October 2026), notices, key-project and government-meeting lists, the Hohhot EEB acceptance, proposed-approval and approval lists, and all earlier captured queue material contain no Northern Data Lake item after the 2025 EIA; the Hohhot DRC host failed to connect on 27 October 2026. Claimed in claims.tsv by this fragment.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated (within 85 days) primary record naming the Northern Data Lake / 中数云科 / 中数兴盛 project (New Area or Hohhot government item, contractor or company disclosure) with a construction, completion or operation statement; then admit it as a new site with the substation-centre locator (campus edge, north-west corner) and the site-plan check.
